items.title: Saudi Arabia targets SR550 billion in tourist spending, 200,000 additional hotel rooms by 2030
items.source_excerpt: RIYADH — Saudi Arabia is targeting SR550 billion in tourist spending by 2030, with 200,000 additional hotel rooms already under construction, Minister of Tourism Ahmed Al-Khateeb said. Speaking at the Budget 2027 Forum in Riyadh on Wednesday, Al-Khateeb said tourist spending had risen from approximately SR120 billion in 2019 to SR304 billion in 2025.
